CAM++ — Hui Wang, Siqi Zheng, Yafeng Chen, Luyao Cheng and Qian Chen. Published by 3D-Speaker/ModelScope iic under Apache-2.0. Publisher-stated training data: VoxCeleb2, 5,994 speakers. OneSpeech runs the released weights without training or fine-tuning; retain the Apache-2.0 licence and upstream notices.

ECAPA-TDNN — Brecht Desplanques, Jenthe Thienpondt and Kris Demuynck; SpeechBrain pretrained implementation/checkpoint. Apache-2.0. Publisher-stated training data: VoxCeleb1 and VoxCeleb2 training sets. OneSpeech runs the released weights without training or fine-tuning; retain the Apache-2.0 licence and upstream notices.

CAM++ — Hui Wang, Siqi Zheng, Yafeng Chen, Luyao Cheng and Qian Chen. Published by 3D-Speaker/ModelScope iic under Apache-2.0. Publisher-stated training data: unnamed large Chinese speaker dataset, over 100,000 speakers. OneSpeech runs the released weights without training or fine-tuning; retain the Apache-2.0 licence and upstream notices.

Omnilingual ASR — Meta AI / Omnilingual ASR Team. Copyright 2025 Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates. Apache-2.0. Retain the Apache-2.0 licence and upstream notices. OneSpeech runs the published checkpoint without training or fine-tuning.
